# Contributing

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before pushing. CI runs the same
command on every push and pull request.

If a change alters something a design note describes, update the note in the
same pull request. Reviewers ask for this. The PR template checklist covers
this and the commit-splitting rule below.
